verdict.rationale: The pack contains no documentation of an event-ingestion endpoint, payload schema, or wire protocol that a custom client could use to send events without an official SDK. The documented OpenAPI v3 API is for reading and processing existing Raygun data, not ingesting events. A community note that the open-source providers let a user write a NancyFX provider shows extension of the official SDK code, which is a developer building block rather than a documented open ingestion protocol.

support.subject: As a developer, the event-ingestion protocol is documented and open enough that custom clients and compatible SDKs can send events without an official SDK
